newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-LIGIER SIGN JAPANESE DRIVER NAKANO.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-LIGIER SIGN JAPANESE DRIVER NAKANO.

text.p: The French Ligier motor racing team said on Tuesday said they had signed Japanese driver Shinji Nakano for the 1997 Formula One world championship season.
Nakano will partner Frenchman Olivier Panis in the team under a year's contract.

The 25-year-old Nakano, who finished on the podium three times in the 1996 Japanese Formula 3000 championship, drove about 1,000 kms in the Ligier JS43 during tests at the Suzuka, Barcelona and Paul Ricard tracks in October and November.
Ligier team chief Flavio Briatore said: "The tests Shinji has done for us in Japan, Spain and the south of France allowed us to gauge his potential.
"We were able very quickly to realise that he is ripe for Formula One."
